item.title: What I Use
item.description: The following stuff is all things I use to do the things I do and create the things I create. Computers As is the nature of working in IT, I own more machines than I can probably remember of varying ages and states of functioning. However, day-to-day I use: Mac Mini M4 (24GB/500GB/1Gb Ethernet - wishing I had gone for the 10Gb model) Macbook Air M1 (8GB/128GB model)
